headline: Volume of regulated crypto market turnover grows in Kyrgyzstan
summary: Regulated crypto trading volume in Kyrgyzstan is increasing, according to a deputy chairman of the National Agency, speaking at the Asia Innovation Forum 2026. The regulated market is expanding.
why: Regulated crypto markets set the legal framework for trading volumes, which matters for exchanges, investors and the wider digital asset sector.
original_headline: В Кыргызстане растет объем регулируемого оборота крипторынка
